summary: Learn MLOps with MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions. Build production-ready ML pipelines and monitoring workflows in 5 days.
lede: MLOps applies DevOps practices to machine learning so professionals can move models into production through repeatable, controlled workflows. For data scientists, machine-learning engineers, and DevOps professionals, it addresses the practical task of releasing and operating models with traceability and control. You will practice versioning data and code, tracking experiments, automating pipeline tests and deployments, and monitoring performance, drift, and data quality to guide operational responses and retraining.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with machine learning and now need to operationalize models in production with traceability and control.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of machine learning model development, basic Python, and familiarity with Git concepts. You should be comfortable training or evaluating a supervised model, reading logs, and working with command-line or notebook-based workflows. Programming is required for hands-on labs, but the course stays focused on operational application rather than software engineering depth.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
